record_scope_reconstruction: The March 1 2018 announcement distinguishes eight road posts from the separately reopened Amuzang railway. Five named road complexes are independently identified in fresh OSM and paired by the official Uzbek trade directory. Candidate controls near Kushkent, Uchturgan and Ravat are unnamed; their precise identity is not yet corroborated sufficiently.
